verdict.rationale: HubSpot documents an official HubSpot MCP server that gives any MCP-compatible AI tool or agent read and write access to CRM data, plus a separate CLI-based Developer MCP server for agentic development tools. A probe confirms the official MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: documented setup and authentication details, an enumerated tool list or scope limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent connecting successfully.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The HubSpot MCP server enables you to give any MCP-compatible AI tool or agent secure read and write access to your HubSpot CRM data — contacts, deals, engagements, and more.
The Developer MCP server enables your agentic development tools to interact with the HubSpot Developer Platform via the CLI.
